attributes.name: can_compare_ab
attributes.doc: Returns true if the Device has the capability to AB compare.

attributes.name: can_have_chains
attributes.doc: Returns true if the device is a rack.

attributes.name: can_have_drum_pads
attributes.doc: Returns true if the device is a drum rack.

attributes.name: class_display_name
attributes.doc: Return const access to the name of the device's class name as displayed in Live's browser and device chain

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.doc: Return const access to the name of the device's class.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.doc: Return const access to whether this device is active. This will be false bothwhen the device is off and when it's inside a rack device which is off.

attributes.name: is_using_compare_preset_b
attributes.doc: Returns whether the Device has loaded the preset in compare slot B. Only relevant if can_compare_ab, otherwise errors.

attributes.name: latency_in_ms
attributes.doc: Returns the latency of the device in ms.

attributes.name: latency_in_samples
attributes.doc: Returns the latency of the device in samples.

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: Return access to the name of the device.

attributes.name: selected_engine
attributes.doc: Return what Voice Engine is selected

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Return the type of the device.
